note: The home page's rotating clip library, proposed. edge-ogt-engine reads a copy of this file (approved clips only ship); ogt-coursecraft authors the clips and delivers mp4 + poster + captions to the course bucket under rail/; growogtx flips `approved` after the owner's word. `rung` is the trust-ladder step the clip answers: 1 who is this · 2 is it real · 3 is he honest · 4 someone like me · 5 what it does to my life · 6 what it costs to find out. `rights`: ken = Ken's own recording; sta = the Society of Technical Analysts' recording (one permission ask covers both STA sources).

rungs.1: Who is this? Others vouch for him on tape.
rungs.2: Is it real? His own screens, his own trades, a free chapter.
rungs.3: Is he honest? He says what does not work.
rungs.4: Is it for someone like me? Students in their own words.
rungs.5: What will it do to my life? The family-future beat.
rungs.6: What does it cost to find out? Free chapter, $19.97 to $79, the daily note.

rotation.first_visit: a rung-1 clip (who is this); the Bollinger collage while approved alone
rotation.return_visit: the next rung the visitor has not seen, from the cookie; never the same clip twice until the library is exhausted
rotation.after_50pct: the up-next strip leads with the matching course trailer (rung 2) so the next click is a product
rotation.unapproved: never served; ?rail=<id> previews one clip for the owner
rotation.retire: after 500 impressions a clip in the bottom third on revenue per 100 impressions (then CTA rate) leaves the rotation; the next approved clip takes its slot; reviewed monthly in the growth report
